author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

`portablecollection::size_cast` builds its exception message by concatenating strings, using `std::to_string` for the value.

`PortableCollectionCommon.h` is included in CUDA device code, where `nvcc` cannot compile `std::format` with GCC 16 in c++23 mode with `--expt-relaxed-constexpr`.

See https://developer.nvidia.com/bugs/7145061 and https://github.com/fwyzard/nvidia_bug_7145061 .

#### PR validation:

None.
title: Build the `size_cast` error message without `std::format`
